user.title: EG Austria token

data_description.token: Personal token or session cookie value. Surrounding quotes and `portal.jwtToken=` are removed automatically.

token_expiry.title: Personal token expiry
token_expiry.description: The integration can't read the expiry of a personal token. Enter the date you chose when creating it (the portal default is one year). You get a repair warning 30 days before.

expiring_soon.title: Session token expires soon
expiring_soon.description: This session token expires in {days} days. Setup continues, but you will have to paste a new token soon. A personal token avoids this.

member.title: Member
member.description: This login can act for several members. Choose the one to add.

accept_terms.title: Portal terms
accept_terms.description: The portal reports that the terms of use for this member have not been accepted yet. Log in to the member portal in a browser and accept them, or the data requests may fail.

location.title: Location
location.description: Choose the location (site) for this entry. Add another entry for another location.

site.title: Metering points
site.description: Choose the metering points of this site. The site slug is part of the statistic ids (`eg_austria:<site>_consumption` ...) and can't be changed later.

data_description.site_slug: Lower case letters, digits and `_`, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters. The statistics are shown as "Home".

communities.title: Energy communities

reauth_confirm.title: New EG Austria token
reauth_confirm.description: The stored token was rejected or has expired. Paste a new personal token (recommended, see {readme_url}) or session cookie of the same member.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EG Austria
reconfigure.description: Optionally paste a new token before the current one expires (see {readme_url}). Leave empty to keep the stored token. Next you can change the metering points and add communities.

reconfigure_location.title: Location changed
reconfigure_location.description: The stored location is no longer returned by the portal (its id may have changed). Choose the location this site belongs to; statistic ids stay the same.

reconfigure_communities.title: Energy communities

error.invalid_token_format: This is neither a personal token (`ecapi_…`) nor a session token (JWT).
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different member.
error.terms_not_accepted: The portal rejected the request. Accept the terms of use in the member portal first.
error.no_member: No member is linked to this login.
error.cannot_connect: The portal can't be reached right now. Try again later.
error.api_changed: The portal answered in an unexpected format. Please report an issue.
error.no_metering_point: Select at least one metering point.
error.no_community: The selected metering points are in no energy community (or none is selected).
error.invalid_slug: Use 1-20 lower case letters, digits or `_`, starting with a letter.
error.slug_in_use: This site slug is already used by another entry.
error.duplicate_slug: This slug is already used in this entry.

abort.already_configured: This member and location are already configured.
abort.no_location: The portal returned no location for this member.
abort.no_metering_points: The location has no metering points.
abort.too_many_communities: More energy communities than this version supports.

data.import_history: Import history from the first activation

data_description.max_hourly_kwh: Hourly values above this are held back as implausible.
data_description.daily_window_days: The last days fetched again on every daily run.
data_description.long_refetch_months: Months fetched again by the monthly run (late corrections).
